IC1: - Female with surgically-confirmed endometriosis, determined at laparoscopy performed within 3y prior to study baseline
IC3: - Current use ≥ 2 months duration of hormonal therapy such as combined oral contraceptives, [OR] norethindrone acetate, [OR] or levonorgestrel intrauterine device
IC4: - Current pelvic pain (score ≥ 3 on Visual Analog Scale, where 0 represents absence of pain and 10 indicates unbearable pain) present for ≥ 14 days/month over the 2 months prior to study enrollment
IC5: - Willingness to comply with visit schedule and protocol
